post.description: Creates a webhook for one event type on the authenticated account. The URL must use HTTPS and resolve to a public address. Save the returned id for deletion and secret for decrypting deliveries. Deliveries contain a JSON payload field encrypted with AES-256-GCM and an X-Phasio-Signature HMAC-SHA256 header.

post.summary: Recognize a single part from a camera image
post.description: Analyses an image and returns the top-N most visually similar part revisions. This is a simpler, 'raw' alternative to the /detect-and-embed endpoint

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100)

200.description: Top-N matching part revisions with their similarity scores

post.summary: Detect parts in an image and find similar part revisions per detection
post.description: Detect parts in the image and, for each detected part, returns the top-N visually similar part revisions. Bounding boxes are in original-image pixel coordinates ([x, y, width, height]) so the consumer can overlay them on the uploaded image.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of similar part revisions per detection (1-100)

200.description: Per-detection bounding boxes with their top-N matching part revisions
